items.quote: Registration verification used to take a week; now it is done in two days because every document is in one place.
items.name: Dewi Lestari
items.role: Head of Administration, sample high school

items.quote: Teachers can check student status themselves without waiting for us to open the archive.
items.name: Ahmad Fauzi

items.q: Is school data stored on our own server?
items.a: Yes, if you want. The portal can run on the school or foundation server, or be hosted by us. The data stays the school's.

items.q: Can we import from existing spreadsheets?
items.a: Yes. Student data is imported from CSV or Excel with column mapping, then verified before saving.
Access is per role: admin, administration staff, and teachers. Each role sees only the relevant menus and data.

items.q: What if the school stops subscribing?
items.a: All data can be exported at any time. After cancellation the account is disabled and data is deleted on request.
